title: R12-2 germanium integrated circuit schematic, 1961-1962 RUS
description: P12-2, the first Soviet production monolithic IC - a germanium 2NAND gate. Exactly who, when and how invented it remains a controversy. The first substantial batch was built at the Riga fab (later known as Alfa) in the end of 1961. R12-2 germanium integrated circuit schematic, 1961-1962 RUS
P12-2, the first Soviet production monolithic IC - a germanium 2NAND gate. Exactly who, when and how invented it remains a controversy. The first substantial batch was built at the Riga fab (later known as Alfa) in the end of 1961. Two, three or four such circuits were packaged into Kvant series micromodules that were used by Gnome airporne digital computers.
